query:
SELECT ms.sha256,
               ms.media_url,
               ms.content_type AS mimetype,
               ms.size
          FROM media_storage ms
          JOIN media_storage_priority msp
            ON msp.storage_provider = ms.storage_provider
         WHERE ms.sha256 = $1
           AND ms.media_block_id IS NULL
         ORDER BY msp.priority
         LIMIT 1
